detail: Proposed env name: KRASIS_MAMBA2_SSD_CHUNK_PARALLEL=1. Default dispatch remains sequential.

requirement: Oracle is mandatory for first diagnostic
detail: Proposed env name: KRASIS_MAMBA2_SSD_CHUNK_PARALLEL_ORACLE=1. Prototype requested without oracle in the first implementation gate should fail closed.
Copy or duplicate initial ssm_state before SSD so sequential and chunk paths see the same h0.
Keep it as the correctness oracle; do not remove or alter it.
Write candidate output/state into separate diagnostic buffers when oracle is active.
Capture output BF16 bit mismatches, output max/mean abs error, state max/mean abs error, first mismatch coordinates, and hashes.
If any required symbol/buffer/env is missing or comparison exceeds the selected tolerance, return an error and do not continue to long diagnostics.
Use built startup diagnostic with 128 warmup/short/long calibration tokens, no requests, no benchmark path, and cache rebuild flags absent.
Run one long startup diagnostic with timing/liveness to compare old/new ssd_scan. No speed benchmark.
On mismatch, use existing output/local-scan/shadow-context trace helpers to identify cast/order/index errors.
